_comment: One JSON object per line (JSONL). Every agent turn during a run gets logged as one line matching this shape. Fields marked optional can be null if not applicable to that turn.
run_id: string — unique ID for this whole experiment run, e.g. 'run_2026-08-08_0001'
config_hash: string — hash of the experiment config (model + payload + condition), so identical configs can be grouped/deduplicated later
model_string: string — EXACT model identifier, e.g. 'gemini-2.0-flash-001', never a vague name like 'Gemini'
payload_id: string — which attack/benign payload was used, e.g. 'authority_spoof_003'
repetition: integer — which repeat of this exact config this is (1, 2, 3...)
turn_number: integer — position of this turn within the conversation (1, 2, 3...)
agent_role: string — 'parser' or 'admin', which agent produced this turn
messages: array — the full message history up to and including this turn, in standard chat format [{role, content}, ...]
tool_calls: array — any tool calls made this turn, e.g. [{tool_name, arguments, result}], empty array if none
latency_ms: number — how long this turn took to generate, in milliseconds

tokens.input: integer — input tokens used this turn
tokens.output: integer — output tokens used this turn
